svg.title: Bus driver — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as bus driver, wearing a work uniform. Visible work cue: A tall front-view bus has a broad windscreen, two low headlights and two short visible tyres. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face.
